steps.en: Due driver notices are picked for the 3rd letter reminder/notification
steps.id: Notice driver yang jatuh tempo dipilih untuk 3rd letter reminder/notification
steps.why_en: The daily run is switched off in the code; letters only start through a manual trigger.
steps.why_id: Jalan harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya mulai lewat trigger manual.

steps.en: Letter uses the driver's latest name and address
steps.id: Surat memakai nama dan alamat driver terbaru
steps.why_en: Newer address may not be used, and some ID types are not refreshed.
steps.why_id: Alamat baru bisa tidak terpakai, dan sebagian jenis ID tidak diperbarui.

steps.en: A data file for the 3rd letter reminder/notification is built for the printer
steps.id: File data 3rd letter reminder/notification dibuat untuk percetakan

steps.en: The file is sent to the vendor securely
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor secara aman
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is blocked by configuration, so the file does not leave.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor diblokir konfigurasi, jadi file tidak keluar.

steps.en: The notice moves to its next stage after sending
steps.id: Notice pindah ke tahap berikutnya setelah pengiriman
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the file was not delivered.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap maju walau file tidak terkirim.
